messages.subject: Fitting gompertz dynamic
parts:
Hello everyone. That's my first post here, so I hope to be clear enough. I'm running GLMM models (specifically, Dail & Madsen 2011). After running through some model-selection steps that defined Poisson for error, a best detection model, and gompertz for dynamics, I started to add covariates for lambda, gamma, and omega. However, while I was trying to fit a model using Nmix.gof.test a got a warning (50 to be exact): "1: In rbinom(1, N[i, t - 1], omega[i, t - 1]) : NAs produced". Therefore I got no fit statistics. The same happened when I tryed to fit using methods such as Tukey or SSE. I had no such a trouble when fitting a dynamic=trend model (in othe work). So, what am I missing here? I hope some one can help me here.
